views.title: Universal Keyboard Clipboard Manager & Media History

views.markdown:
### Never lose a copied snippet again.

**Yuna** integrates seamlessly into the native iOS keyboard dock, placing a convenient clipboard button right beside your emoji and dictation controls. Easily view, insert, and organize your clipboard history with support for **plain text**, **high-resolution images**, and **file links**.

#### Key Features:
- **Dock Integration**: Native clipboard trigger button in the iOS keyboard dock.
- **Universal Content**: Automatically captures text snippets, copied photos/images, web URLs, and file paths.
- **Pinning Engine**: Pin vital snippets to the top so they are never purged or overwritten.
- **Multi-Row Layout Management**: Configure 1, 2, 3, or 4 rows of snippets in settings to suit your workflow.
- **Direct Insertion**: Injects text directly into the active field without extra taps.
- **Rootless & PAC Safe**: Built for modern Dopamine jailbreaks on arm64 and arm64e (A12/A13) with ElleKit trampolines.

- **Interactive Tap & Paste Fix**: Resolved touch hit-testing in UIKeyboardLayoutStar and YunaPanelView, enabling instantaneous cell tap-to-paste, comfortable 36pt pin button hit targets, and dual direct-injection/clipboard syncing.

- **Reliable In-App Clipboard Capture**: Intercepts all pasteboard write paths in active processes and auto-synchronizes on dock tap, ensuring snippets transfer immediately even across sandboxed apps.
- **Touch Pass-Through Elimination**: Added strict hit-testing overrides on UIKeyboardLayoutStar and YunaPanelView to completely prevent touches in the clipboard panel from pressing keyboard keys underneath.
- **LiquidGlass & SpringBoard Stability**: Completely removed periodic timers and blocking main-runloop pasteboard IPC in SpringBoard, eliminating watchdog freezes and hitches when running with visual tweaks like Liquid(Gl)ass.

- **Native Sileo Respring**: Replaced abrupt script respring with native `cydia::respring` tag, displaying Sileo's native "Restart SpringBoard" prompt.
- **Dock Alignment**: Perfectly aligned clipboard icon with the language switcher row on the right side of the keyboard.
- **Package Artwork**: Added official character icon and depiction banner.

- Initial release in the Nishi repository.
- Universal keyboard dock clipboard button.
- Text, image, and file URL clipboard capture.
- Snippet pinning with eviction protection.
- Customizable row layout (1 to 4 rows).
- Native Sileo depiction and rootless Dopamine support.
